The '''''Watcher''''' was a customs [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that served in the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was used as a customs [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
